EZMB_TEMPORARY.title: Temporary
EZMB_TEMPORARY.description: This card only exists during this combat. It is removed after combat.
EZMB_PLANTED.title: Plant
EZMB_PLANTED.description: A planted card does not enter your hand and is removed from this combat. Planting is not playing, discarding, or exhausting, and those triggers do not fire. A planted Blight Sprout is treated as handled and adds no Rootblight I after combat; a planted Rootblight is not removed, downgraded, or worsened this combat.
